shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a white shirt sits in the plant-side window seat and poses a riddle, a man in a blue shirt sits in the counter-side window seat, and a woman in a yellow shirt sits in the plant-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the café counter end, looking along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and the plant-end seat and the floor plant in frame.

shots.content: A man in a blue shirt leaves his seat and exits the café, while a man in a white shirt asks for the answer.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A man in a white shirt explains the riddle's answer.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the rectangular table.
